Definition: to droop; by implication to be sick, to mourn
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be weak, to droop, to languish, to be exhausted; 1a) (Qal) pass participle (of the heart); 1a1) to be weak; 1a2) to droop; 1b) (Pulal); 1b1) to be or grow feeble; 1b2) to languish
